info.title: Notion API
info.description: Notion API 2025-09-03 - Data Source Edition. Breaking change: Database endpoints replaced with data source endpoints.

recovery_kind.description: The recovery action selected by Notion for the caller.

recovery_url.description: Present when recovery_kind directs the caller to a settings page.

id.description: The ID of the comment.

discussion_id.description: The ID of the discussion thread this comment belongs to.

created_time.description: The time when the comment was created.

last_edited_time.description: The time when the comment was last edited.

created_by.description: The user who created the comment.

rich_text.description: The rich text content of the comment.

display_name.description: The display name of the comment.

original_content_deleted.description: Whether this comment's original content was deleted.

has_pending_attachments.description: Whether any file attachments on this comment are still uploading. Pending files are not listed in `attachments` yet. A `comment.updated` webhook is sent when each upload finishes.

attachments.description: Any file attachments associated with the comment.

property_id.description: The ID of the database property the comment is on, for comments on a page property. Matches the property's `id` in the page object. Omitted for other comments.

expiry_time.description: The time when the URL will expire.

mention.description: Mention objects represent an inline mention of a database, date, link preview mention, page, template mention, or user. A mention is created in the Notion UI when a user types `@` followed by the name of the reference.

name.description: The name of the custom emoji.

end.description: The end date of the date object, if any.

time_zone.description: The time zone of the date object.

bot.description: Details about the bot, when the `type` of the user is `bot`.

avatar_url.description: The avatar URL of the user.

email_verified.description: Whether the person's email is verified.

person.description: The person info of the user.

user.description: Details about the owner of the bot, when the `type` of the owner is `user`. This means the bot is for a integration.

workspace.description: Details about the owner of the bot, when the `type` of the owner is `workspace`. This means the bot is for an internal integration.

content.description: The actual text content of the text.

annotations.description: All rich text objects contain an annotations object that sets the styling for the rich text.

bold.description: Whether the text is formatted as bold.

italic.description: Whether the text is formatted as italic.

strikethrough.description: Whether the text is formatted with a strikethrough.

underline.description: Whether the text is formatted with an underline.

code.description: Whether the text is formatted as code.

type.description: Whether the result set is complete or incomplete. `incomplete` means the response does not include all rows that match the query parameters (e.g. due to a server-side pagination depth limit).

incomplete_reason.description: Why the result set is incomplete. Only present when `type` is `incomplete`.

id.description: The ID of the database.

parent.description: The parent of the database. This is typically a page, block, or workspace, but can be another database in the case of wikis.

database_type.description: The type of typed database, such as `tasks`, `projects`, or `skills`, or `null` for a regular database. Create a database accepts `tasks`, `projects`, and `skills`.

in_trash.description: Whether the database is in the trash.

is_locked.description: Whether the database is locked from editing in the Notion app UI.

show_data_source_title.description: Whether the data source title is shown above the database's views, matching the Show data source title toggle in the Notion app. Full-page databases with one data source don't show this title even when this is `true`.

created_time.description: The time when the database was created.

last_edited_time.description: The time when the database was last edited.

data_sources.description: The data sources of the database.

public_url.description: The public URL of the database if it is publicly accessible.

type.description: Type of cover. In this case, an external URL.

url.description: The URL of the external file or resource.

external.description: The external URL for the cover.

type.description: Type of cover. In this case, a file.

file.description: The file URL for the cover.

type.description: Type of icon. In this case, a Notion native icon.

icon.description: The Notion native icon, specified by name and color.

name.description: The name of the Notion icon (e.g. pizza, meeting, home). See the Notion icon picker for valid names.

color.description: The color variant of the icon. Valid values: gray, lightgray, brown, yellow, orange, green, blue, purple, pink, red.

type.description: Type of icon. In this case, a custom emoji.

custom_emoji.description: The custom emoji details for the icon.

id.description: The ID of the data source.

name.description: The name of the data source.

health.description: Live collection sync health. Null means unavailable, not unhealthy. Missing timestamps are unknown.

owner_user_id.description: Notion user who owns the sync credential, included when health is available.

resource.description: Provider resource synced to this data source, when available.

sync_id.description: The stored sync ID. This is not a credential.

provider.description: The sync provider: github (GitHub), jira (Jira), or salesforce (Salesforce).

external_database_sync.description: Stored identity of an external database sync.

external_collection_type.description: The provider of a legacy synced data source: Jira or Salesforce. Values are case-sensitive.

sync_id.description: The stored sync ID when provider details are unavailable. This is not a credential.

syncing.description: Stored legacy sync state: true means syncing, false means not syncing, and row_limit_exceeded means the row limit stopped syncing. False does not guarantee a successful sync.

last_synced_at.description: Stored legacy sync update time in UTC ISO 8601 format. This does not guarantee that all source changes have been imported.

last_sync_checkpoint_at.description: Stored legacy sync checkpoint time in UTC ISO 8601 format.

last_sync_heartbeat_at.description: Stored legacy sync heartbeat time in UTC ISO 8601 format.

sync_state.description: Stored state for a legacy synced data source. Missing or invalid timestamps are omitted. This is not a live health check.

synced_collection_key.description: Opaque, developer-defined collection key for a worker sync. It is not a globally unique ID or a credential. Worker status is not included.

sync_metadata.description: Sync identity and available health, included when retrieving a database.

color.description: The color variant of the icon. Defaults to gray if not specified. Valid values: gray, lightgray, brown, yellow, orange, green, blue, purple, pink, red.

options.description: The initial status options. If not provided, defaults are created.

expires_at.description: When the cached query results expire.

total_count.description: Total number of results in the query.

results.description: The page results for this page.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page of results.

request_status.description: Set to `{ type: 'incomplete', incomplete_reason: 'query_result_limit_reached' }` when the view's underlying data source has more rows matching this query than the server-side pagination depth limit allows.

id.description: The object ID.

page_size.description: The number of results to return per page. Maximum: 100

id.description: The ID of the view.

parent.description: The parent database of the view.

created_time.description: The time when the view was created.

last_edited_time.description: The time when the view was last edited.

url.description: Canonical deep link to the view in Notion.

data_source_id.description: The ID of the data source this view is scoped to, or null for dashboard views.

created_by.description: The user who created the view, or null if not available.

last_edited_by.description: The user who last edited the view, or null if not available.

filter.description: The filter applied to this view (same shape as data source query filter).

sorts.description: The sorts applied to this view (same shape as data source query sorts).

quick_filters.description: Quick filters pinned to the view's filter bar. Keys are property IDs. Values are filter conditions (same shape as a property filter without the property field). Null when no quick filters are set.

dashboard_view_id.description: For dashboard widget views, the ID of the parent dashboard view. Only present when this view is a widget inside a dashboard.

viewConfigResponse.description: View configuration, typed by view type (table, board, calendar, etc.).

rows.description: The rows that make up the dashboard layout. Each row contains one or more widget modules.

id.description: The ID of this row module.

widgets.description: The widget modules within this row.

height.description: Fixed height of the row in pixels.

id.description: The ID of this widget module.

view_id.description: The ID of the collection view rendered by this widget.

width.description: Width of the widget in a 12-column grid (1-12). 12 means full width.

row_index.description: The 0-based index of the row this widget belongs to. Widgets in the same row share the same row_index.

chart_type.description: The chart type: column (vertical bars), bar (horizontal bars), line, donut, or number (single value display).

x_axis.description: X-axis grouping configuration for column/bar/line/donut charts using grouped data. Null when using results (raw property values) mode.

y_axis.description: Y-axis aggregation for column/bar/line/donut charts using grouped data. Null when using results mode.

x_axis_property_id.description: Property ID for the x-axis name values when using results (raw property values) mode.

y_axis_property_id.description: Property ID for the y-axis numeric values when using results (raw property values) mode.

value.description: Aggregation configuration for number charts (single value display).

hide_empty_groups.description: Whether to hide groups with no data on the x-axis.

legend_position.description: Legend display position. "off" hides the legend.

show_data_labels.description: Whether to show data value labels on chart elements.

cumulative.description: Whether to show cumulative values (line charts only).

smooth_line.description: Whether to use smooth curves (line charts only).

hide_line_fill_area.description: Whether to hide the shaded area under the line (line charts only).

group_style.description: How grouped/stacked bars are displayed. "normal" stacks values, "percent" normalizes to 100%, "side_by_side" places bars next to each other.

y_axis_min.description: Custom minimum value for the y-axis. Null clears the override.

y_axis_max.description: Custom maximum value for the y-axis. Null clears the override.

donut_labels.description: What to display on donut chart slices.

hide_title.description: Whether to hide the title label (number charts only).

stack_by.description: Stack-by grouping configuration for stacked/grouped bar charts (column/bar/line only). Null when not stacked.

reference_lines.description: Reference lines drawn on the chart. Null when no reference lines are configured.

caption.description: Text caption displayed below the chart. Null when no caption is shown.

color_by_value.description: Whether chart elements are colored by their numeric value (gradient coloring).

id.description: Unique identifier for the reference line.

value.description: The y-axis value where the reference line is drawn.

label.description: Label displayed alongside the reference line.

dash_style.description: Line style: "solid" for a continuous line, "dash" for a dashed line.

group_by.description: Sub-group-by configuration based on the formula result type.

status_show_as.description: How to display status properties (as select dropdown or checkbox).

card_property_width_mode.description: Property width mode in compact card layouts (board/gallery).

date_format.description: Date display format (date properties only). "full" = localized full date, "short" = month and day, "month_day_year" = MM/DD/YYYY, "day_month_year" = DD/MM/YYYY, "year_month_day" = YYYY/MM/DD, "relative" = relative dates.

display_mode.description: How sub-items are displayed. "show" renders hierarchically with toggles, "hidden" shows parents with a count, "flattened" shows sub-items with a parent indicator, "disabled" turns off sub-item rendering.

toggle_column_id.description: Property ID of the column showing the sub-item expand/collapse toggle.

viewFilterResponse.description: Filter for the view. Can be a property filter (filter by property value), timestamp filter (filter by created_time or last_edited_time), or compound filter (combine filters with and/or logic). Compound filters support up to 2 levels of nesting.

filter.description: Filter to apply to the view. Uses the same format as the data source query filter. Pass null to clear the filter.

sorts.description: Property sorts to apply to the view. Only property-based sorts are supported. Pass null to clear the sorts.

quick_filters.description: Quick filters for the view's filter bar. Keys are property names or IDs. Set a key to a filter condition to add/update that quick filter. Set a key to null to remove it. Pass null for the entire field to clear all quick filters. Unmentioned quick filters are preserved.

configuration.description: View presentation configuration. The type field must match the view type. Individual nullable fields within the configuration can be set to null to clear them.

query.description: The text that the API compares page and database titles against.

sort.description: A set of criteria, `direction` and `timestamp` keys, that orders the results. The **only** supported timestamp value is `"last_edited_time"`. Supported `direction` values are `"ascending"` and `"descending"`. If `sort` is not provided, then the most recently edited results are returned first.

direction.description: The direction to sort. Possible values include `ascending` and `descending`.

timestamp.description: The name of the timestamp to sort against. Possible values include `last_edited_time`.

filter.description: A set of criteria, `value` and `property` keys, that limits the results to either only pages or only data sources. Possible `value` values are `"page"` or `"data_source"`. The only supported `property` value is `"object"`.

value.description: The value of the property to filter the results by.  Possible values for object type include `page` or `data_source`.  **Limitation**: Currently the only filter allowed is `object` which will filter by type of object (either `page` or `data_source`)

property.description: The name of the property to filter by. Currently the only property you can filter by is the object type.  Possible values include `object`.   Limitation: Currently the only filter allowed is `object` which will filter by type of object (either `page` or `data_source`)

start_cursor.description: A `cursor` value returned in a previous response that If supplied, limits the response to results starting after the `cursor`.
